title: Olivia and the Wobbly Ruler
subtitle: Heavy middles stand tall
author: Olivia's Shelf
blurb: Olivia stands a ruler on its end, watches it tip, and learns that every thing has a quiet middle — and a wide base keeps that middle from falling over.

magic.launch: The little rocket pushed the air, and the air pushed back.
magic.drop: Everything falls. That pull has a name: gravity.

grok.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

openai.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

pages.heading: It tips
pages.text: {Olivia} stood a ruler on its end. It {tipped}. "{Elon:elon/look}," she said. "It will not stay."

pages.heading: A quiet middle
pages.text: "Every thing has a quiet {middle} where its heaviness gathers," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "We call it the center of mass."

pages.heading: When it leans
pages.text: "If that middle hangs past the {base}, the thing {tips}," said Elon. Olivia leaned the ruler. Down it went.

pages.heading: Spread your feet
pages.text: Olivia stood a book on its wide face. It stayed. "A wide base is harder to {tip}," said {Elon:elon/teach}.

pages.heading: A long helper
pages.text: "A tightrope walker holds a long pole," said Elon. "The pole helps keep the middle over the {rope}."

pages.heading: Keep asking why
pages.text: "Why is it easier to stand with feet apart?" asked {Olivia:olivia/ask}. "You made a wider {base}," said {Elon:elon/teach}.

end.heading: The End
end.text: Every thing has a quiet middle. Keep that middle over a wide base, and it stands.
end.prompt: What would you try to balance tomorrow?

credits: Painted for Olivia's Shelf. Elon is a picture-book inventor who teaches physics; this is not a biography.
